name: Ghost Light
description: Ghost Light is a lively and eclectic venue known for its vibrant live music, comedy, and open mic nights. It offers a warm, divey atmosphere with friendly staff and a diverse crowd that supports local artists and performers. The venue features a good sound system, a variety of entertainment options, and a welcoming environment that makes every visit feel special. Its affordability and community vibe make it a favorite spot for both casual nights out and special events.
